newsitem.title: PERU: Miners take Lima bolsa to slightly higher close.
newsitem.headline: Miners take Lima bolsa to slightly higher close.

text.p: The Lima Stock Exchange made slight overall gains Thursday as mining stocks drew investor interest in an otherwise static market, brokers said.
They predicted quiet, stable trading Friday on an absence of strong corporate or economic news.

According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index gained 0.64 percent to 2,175.73 points while the blue- chip index gained 0.13 percent to 3,126.52 on volume of 81.5 million soles ($31 million) in 2,197 operations.
